rules.sentence: Physical findings should be carefully assessed during an ictal event to confirm seizure activity and possibly identify the underlying cause.
Accurate recognition of seizure semiology is essential for diagnosis, especially when electroencephalographic (EEG) correlation is limited.

Focal motor movements may suggest ischemic stroke or localized hemorrhage, whereas generalized motor phenomena raise concern for hypoxic-ischemic injury, infection, or multifocal stroke or hemorrhage.
